leakage_findings.issue: Absolute dev-machine path '/Users/yuqic/Documents/Claude/Projects/STAI-X challenge/award-b-repo' hardcoded as REPO_ROOT. Persists from round 1. Breaks on any other machine or CI path.
leakage_findings.required_fix: Resolve REPO_ROOT at runtime via Path(__file__).resolve().parents[N] or an environment variable, never a literal absolute path.

leakage_findings.issue: Title strings ('Mr', 'Miss', 'Mrs', 'Master', 'Don', 'Rev', etc.) and ordinal mapping are Titanic-specific literals hardcoded in the pipeline. Persists from round 1. Violates no-hardcoding rule.
leakage_findings.required_fix: Build title vocabulary dynamically by extracting unique titles from the Name column at runtime, assign ordinals by frequency rank, and preserve the Rare-fallback pattern without hardcoding individual title strings.

leakage_findings.issue: feature_importance.json still lists only 5 raw floor-model columns (Pclass, Age, SibSp, Parch, Fare). The 28-column engineered feature set (tgt_mean_title, is_alone, fare_per_person, is_child, is_large_family, etc.) has no recorded importance. Persists from round 1.
leakage_findings.required_fix: Populate feature_importance.json from specialist models (gbdt/linear) that train on the engineered feature_spec.json columns, not the floor model's raw columns.

suggestions.suggestion: Add tgt_mean_title x Pclass interaction. title already encodes social status and Pclass is the strongest floor-model feature (importance 0.338). Their product captures high-survival segments (e.g. Mrs in Pclass 1) beyond separate tgt_mean_title and tgt_mean_Pclass features.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Inside fold loop after computing tgt_mean_title: tgt_mean_title_x_Pclass = fold_val['_title'].map(title_grp_mean) * fold_val['Pclass']. Apply full-train version to prediction frame. Declare source=per_fold in feature_spec.json.

suggestions.suggestion: Add Age_x_Pclass interaction. Age (floor importance 0.077) and Pclass (0.338) are the two strongest numerics. Their product captures elderly 3rd-class passengers (low survival) vs young 1st-class passengers not covered by Sex_x_Age alone.
suggestions.implementation_hint: feat_train['Age_x_Pclass'] = oof_arrays['Age_imputed'] * train_raw['Pclass'].values; for pred frame use feat_pred['Age'] * pred_raw['Pclass'].values.

suggestions.suggestion: Add fare_per_person binned (quartile ordinal). fare_per_person is a continuous ratio; Fare has floor importance 0.257. Quartile encoding (fit on fold-train boundaries) exposes nonlinear Fare/family_size thresholds to linear models in the ensemble.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Inside fold loop: pd.qcut(fold_train['fare_per_person'], q=4, duplicates='drop') to get bin edges; apply to fold_val and prediction frame. Encode as ordinal int 0-3.

suggestions.suggestion: Once specialists populate feature_importance.json on the 28-column set, prune features whose importance falls below the bottom decile of the observed distribution. Likely candidates: Emb_Q (sparse Embarked=Q), is_large_family (collinear with family_size).
suggestions.implementation_hint: Sort specialist feature importances; drop columns below bottom-decile threshold that lack ablation evidence (i.e. not in the per_fold_aggregates group which showed delta=-0.013).

notes: Round 2: all 7 per_fold_aggregates (tgt_mean_Sex, tgt_mean_Pclass, tgt_mean_Embarked, tgt_mean_Sex_Pclass, tgt_mean_title, ticket_group_size, ticket_prefix_enc) correctly declared source=per_fold and fit inside the canonical fold loop using fold_assignment from cv_folds.json. CV is stratified_kfold i.i.d. — no time ordering, so ~val_mask train construction carries no forward-look risk. No row_id/PassengerId in feature set. Three low-severity issues (2 hardcoding, 1 stale importance file) carried from round 1; none are CV leakage. New round-2 features (is_alone, fare_per_person, is_child, is_large_family, tgt_mean_title) are all fold-safe.
